claim: Ma Langue Sourit is at 1 rue de Remich, L-5331 Moutfort, Luxembourg.
quote: Address: 1 rue de Remich, L-5331 Moutfort, Luxembourg

claim: Ma Langue Sourit holds two Michelin stars under Chef Cyril Molard.
quote: Ma Langue Sourit – Oetrange – a MICHELIN Guide Restaurant

claim: Chef Cyril Molard earned the restaurant's second Michelin star in 2018 and an 18.5 score in Gault&Millau.
quote: two Michelin stars and a score of 18.5 in the Gault&Millau guide

claim: Luxembourg City to Moutfort is about 12.5 km / 12 minutes by taxi.
quote: The distance between Luxembourg and Moutfort is 7 miles … A taxi from Luxembourg to Moutfort takes 12 minutes

claim: Moutfort to Schengen by car is 19 km / 17 minutes, taxi fare ~€65–80.
quote: the driving distance between Moutfort to Schengen is 19 km … approximately 17 minutes … estimated taxi fare between €65–80

claim: Luxembourg taxi fares are deregulated and set per company; expect ~€3/km plus pickup fee.
Hotel Le Place d'Armes is a 30-room Relais & Châteaux boutique stitched from seven 18th-century townhouses on Place d'Armes.
quote: an unconventional ensemble of buildings, created by putting together 7 houses … 30 luxury rooms and suites

claim: Le Place d'Armes was awarded one Michelin Key — the first Luxembourg hotel to receive the distinction.
quote: Le Place d'Armes | One Michelin Key in Luxembourg City

claim: Les Jardins d'Anaïs is a niche seven-room boutique in the Clausen district with a Michelin-starred restaurant.
Each of the seven rooms at Les Jardins d'Anaïs is themed individually — Provence, African savannah, French colonial library, etc.
quote: seven contemporary rooms is uniquely designed to create a distinct atmosphere, ranging from themes like 'Provence' to 'African savannah' or a rustic 'library' room

claim: La Pipistrelle is a 4-suite B&B behind an 18th-century façade in the UNESCO-listed Grund, with a breakfast room set in a historic rock case from the old fortress.
quote: behind a façade dating from the 18th century, la Pipistrelle offers an unforgettable escape in the Grund District … 4 bedroom suite hotel … rock case lounge which formerly served as a shield for the fortress of Luxembourg

claim: Hotel Parc Beaux-Arts is an 11-suite property in the Gëlle Klack House next to the Palais Grand-Ducal, with beamed ceilings, fireplaces, Murano lighting and medieval stonework.
quote: 11 suites … decorated with original stone features, wooden panels, Murano lighting, Italian design elements and medieval architectural details

claim: Grand Hotel Cravat has stood opposite the Gëlle Fra monument for over 100 years and served as a US Army HQ in WWII.
quote: stood in the heart of Luxembourg city for more than 100 years … headquarters for American troops during WWII

claim: The Marriott Alfa is housed in a 1932 Art Deco building (national monument since 1991) opposite Luxembourg Gare, with interiors by Iria Degen.
quote: historic building that opened in 1932. It was designed by Léon Bouvart and built by Alfred Lefèvre. It has been designated a national monument since 1991

claim: Mondorf Parc Hôtel is a 4-star superior thermal-spa hotel set in a 45-ha park, with direct access to thermal pools and 12 saunas.
quote: 108 rooms and suites … heart of a 45-hectare thermal park … 12 saunas, plus a thermal swimming pool

claim: Domaine la Forêt is a 16-room 4-star hotel between vineyards and woodland in Remich, with a 700 m² spa and a MICHELIN Guide restaurant.
quote: 4-star hotel with 16 rooms, nestled between vineyards and woodland, featuring a restaurant recommended by the MICHELIN Guide and a 700 m² spa

claim: Hotel de l'Ecluse Superior in Stadtbredimus is a design hotel on the Moselle riverbank with every room offering a balcony onto vineyards or river.
quote: 3 star superior design hotel located on the edge of the Moselle River … private balcony and stunning views overlooking either the river or the surrounding vineyards

claim: Château de Schengen reopened in June 2024 after a full renovation, positioned as a heritage-meets-modern character hotel in Schengen village.
quote: Château de Schengen … reopened on June 1, 2024, after a complete renovation … balance between tradition and modernity
